A formal left-aligned serif identity above thin double rules. Keep the dates in a narrow right rail and use small capitals only for section labels.

Use a compact bilingual-friendly masthead, a thin navy perimeter rule and open chronological entries. Long institutions and multilingual names must wrap without shrinking.
Pair a confident serif masthead with a narrow right qualifications rail. Short section rules and sharply aligned dates should feel like a financial briefing.
Use warm grey rules, aligned role and organisation lines, and an understated ledger rhythm. Keep achievements as readable bullets rather than decorative metric boxes.
Education and publications lead an extended CV. Use wide outer margins, a precise date gutter and hanging publication context that continues cleanly across pages.

Use a modest serif masthead, green keylines and unusually clear volunteer entries. Paid and unpaid experience share the same strong hierarchy and readable dates.

Use familiar black-on-white typography with a narrow black rule beside each section heading. Keep every contact detail as selectable text and every entry in natural reading order.
